security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from markdown code fences, relative repository links, and homepage metadata. remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run experiment.py with user-derived numeric inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Require strict numeric validation and pass arguments without shell interpolation. Reject nonnumeric counts, rates, and lift thresholds.

remediation.issue: The helper script path depends on CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
remediation.suggestion: Document that the path must resolve inside the trusted plugin directory before execution.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples and relative repository links create noisy static alerts.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that links are reference-only and that shell snippets are optional trusted helper calls.

content.value_statement: Ad teams often launch tests without enough traffic or clear decision rules. This skill designs experiments and reads results with documented statistical gates.
actual_capabilities: Creates falsifiable hypotheses for ad, creative, landing page, and incrementality tests.
Builds variant matrices that isolate one changed variable per arm.
Plans sample size, duration, power, and no-peeking rules.
Reads exported test results and applies significance plus practical lift gates.
Produces promote, kill, keep-control, or retest decisions with labeled assumptions.
limitations: Does not create ad copy, images, or landing page variants.
Needs baseline rates, traffic estimates, or exported result counts for precise plans.
Does not replace analytics governance or platform-side experiment setup.
External helper use depends on trusted local scripts being available.

use_cases.title: Plan a Creative Test
use_cases.description: Define variants, metrics, sample size, and duration before launching new ad creative.

use_cases.title: Read a Finished Experiment
use_cases.description: Turn exported sessions and conversions into a documented significance decision.

use_cases.title: Design Incrementality Checks
use_cases.description: Structure holdout or geo tests with clear counterfactual logic and decision gates.

prompt_templates.title: Simple A/B Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an A/B test for our landing page hero. Baseline CVR is 3%. Detect a 15% lift.

prompt_templates.title: Creative Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a creative test matrix for four ad concepts. Goal is prospecting. Traffic is 8,000 impressions daily.

prompt_templates.title: Results Readout
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this finished test. Control has 12,000 sessions and 360 conversions. Variant has 11,800 sessions and 402 conversions.

prompt_templates.title: Incrementality Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a geo holdout test for Meta prospecting. Include metrics, duration, guardrails, and promote or kill criteria.

output_examples.input: Plan a landing page A/B test with 3% baseline CVR and 15% minimum lift.
output_examples.output: Hypothesis, two-arm variant matrix, primary CVR metric, guardrails, sample size estimate, duration, and no-peeking rule.

output_examples.input: Read out a completed creative test with sessions and conversions for control and variant.
output_examples.output: Documented rate comparison, relative lift, significance result, practical lift check, and promote or keep-control decision.

output_examples.input: Set up an incrementality test for a prospecting campaign.
output_examples.output: Holdout structure, treated group definition, measurement window, guardrails, required data, and decision rubric.

best_practices: Provide baseline rates, traffic per day, and the minimum lift worth detecting.
Use one changed variable per variant so the winner has a clear cause.
Pre-commit to sample size and duration before checking results.
anti_patterns: Do not stop a test early because one variant looks ahead mid-run.
Do not promote a statistically significant result below the practical lift floor.
Do not mix creative, audience, budget, and landing page changes in one variant.

faq.question: Can this skill generate ad creatives?
faq.answer: No. It designs the test and reads results. Use a creative builder for the actual variants.

faq.question: What inputs improve the plan?
faq.answer: Baseline rate, daily traffic, goal type, minimum lift, variants, and guardrail metrics improve the plan.

faq.question: Can it analyze finished results?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide variant names, exposures, and conversions or clicks from your exported results.

faq.question: Does it use platform APIs?
faq.answer: No API access is required. The skill is designed around user-provided exports and manual inputs.

faq.question: How does it decide promote or kill?
faq.answer: It requires statistical significance and a minimum practical lift, while checking guardrail metrics.

faq.question: Can it design incrementality tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure geo or audience holdouts and define the decision criteria.
